# Synthetic scanned-PDF OCR fixtures

These PDFs are generated entirely from DLMS-authored synthetic text by
`../generate_pdf_fixtures.py`. They are redistribution-safe and cover direct
selectable text, image-only scans, mixed pages, ambiguous low text, multiple
scanned pages, multiple correct answers, and an unlabeled six-choice layout.

They are behavioral fixtures, not an OCR accuracy benchmark.
